The Problem

You don't have a lead problem. You have a shared-lead problem.

You've run the gauntlet. Angi, HomeAdvisor, Thumbtack. You pay for a "lead" that already sold to four competitors before your phone stopped ringing. So you race to dial first, quote against three guys who'll always go cheaper, and close maybe one in five. And the one you close is the price-shopper who walks the second someone undercuts you.

Or you went the old-ad route. You blast a whole zip code and pay Google and Facebook to put your ad in front of renters, tire-kickers, and the guy who replaced his roof last spring.

Here's the math nobody puts on the sales call. In a typical service market, fewer than 3 in 100 households will hire your trade this quarter. Old-way advertising pays to reach all 100. Shared-lead platforms make you knife-fight over the 3.

Both models are built so the platform gets paid whether you close a job or not. You're not their customer. You're their inventory.

The Solution

We stopped guessing who might buy. We find who's already deciding.

Every homeowner leaves a trail before they call anyone. The searches. The review pages. The three websites they check in a week. That trail used to be invisible. It isn't anymore.

EngageEngine™ reads that activity and resolves it to real, named people in your service area. Then it puts your ads in front of those people and nobody else, on Google, on Facebook, on YouTube, everywhere they scroll. You stop paying to reach the 97 households that were never going to call, and start reaching the 3 that will.

Why it works: a homeowner who's about to hire behaves nothing like one who isn't. They binge reviews. They compare maps. They pull up competitor sites back to back. We buy only that behavior, and refuse to spend a dollar of yours on anyone not showing it.

And they're yours alone. One company per trade, per market. The day you lock your territory is the day your competitor can't. That isn't a bonus. It's the product.
